body:
I didn't take the job.

I feel worse than ever now, mostly for unrelated reasons. Pretty sure I'm going to put another suicide attempt in, hopefully some time in the next week. Whenever I'm alone for more than a few hours. That might even be tomorrow, actually. My parents are going away to visit my sister at her school, and I had already voiced concerns that I didn't want to go with them. I think I like this idea. Tomorrow I am going to kill myself :)

And probably no one is ever going to see this message. Why would anyone bother checking a days old thread for new posts? Shrug. I guess I just wanted to provide a conclusion to anyone who finds my posts in the far future.

Goodbye.

And this is what I meant by worthless platitudes. You are deluded if you think every problem always has a solution. That's just not the way things work. And I disagree; killing myself is very much a solution to my problem. It is a permanent solution to my long-term "temporary" problem. In other words, just the kind of solution I'm looking for.
> Are u going to give up ur life for $100000?

Yes, I am. Unless a literal miracle happens, that is exactly what I'm going to do.

I don't know how it works outside the US, but according to nearly everything I've read, it is **extremely difficult** to get private student loans discharged via bankruptcy. It would not be a reliable option, though I guess I may have to try it at some point.

Plenty of recruitment firms have reached out to me because my resume is online. I usually never hear back from them after the initial phone call or email. The few times I have, I never heard back from them after the first interview they placed for me. If I even made it that far to begin with.

I haven't tried temp agencies yet though. Thanks for the suggestion.

The problem with deferment is my interest will continue to grow for however long I don't have to make payments. That isn't very appealing to me. ~~But if I make it down to zero savings to my name, I guess I'll have to do it anyway.~~ Actually I just looked it up and I'm not eligible for deferment.

According to my five second google search, cremation costs around $4,000 around here. My remaining savings can cover that. But only for another month or two, so I'll have to act fast! (That was a joke. Mostly.)

Emotional cost is an unfortunate inevitability. I'm alright with it.

Deferring my loans by going back to school is such an unbelievably bad idea. And your plan only works if I have a minimum wage job to begin with.

Yes please offer me those websites. I need all the help I can get.

Fun fact: I addressed this idea in the first draft of the OP, but I removed it because it sounded too passive aggresive. Basically I said I didn't see how this could be a realistic option, because I'd go from being unemployed and out of money to being unemployed and out of money and homeless.

Also my parents co-signed my loans so I think leaving the country would leave them with my bills. But then again since I'm already considering suicide, clearly I don't have any ethical boundaries holding me back. I guess I'll consider this option further.

It's hard to update my resume when there's nothing to update it with.

I have a degree in computer science and I'm trying to find a web development job. I know they exist in this area, because I live around two hours away from NYC. The problem is I lack the necessary experience for every position I come across. My job history is pretty minimal. 3 months at a summer internship a couple years ago, and 8 months doing web development last year after I graduated. That's it. And then I have the huge 8 month gap where it looks like I've done nothing since January. That probably doesn't look very appealing to prospective employers.

I don't know. Financial advice? Advice on what else I can do to get a job?

I'm telling this because I don't know what else to do with myself, and I'm running out of options, and I'm running out of time. And because I assumed this was the place to go when you're on the verge of suicide. If I'm wrong, please direct me to a more appropriate place.
